facts.fact: The Justice Minister says maintenance and development of the criminal-case system and its subsystems passes to the Institute for Justice Modernisation and Innovation (IMIJ), in coordination with NOSi, which developed and implemented it.
NOSi, described as the Ministry of Justice's technology partner, is stated to be responsible for developing and implementing the Justice Information System for the ministry.

The SIPP criminal-case component of the SIJ, developed by the NOSi team, was formally delivered and is stated to be operating in every comarca; no go-live date is given, so as_of is the delivery date.
